description: This file is a Markdown documentation file for FastAPI, describing how to create custom request and route classes to handle request bodies, such as compressed or non-standard formats, and how to override default behaviors for specialized request processing.

classes.name: GzipRequest
classes.description: A custom subclass of `Request` that overrides the `body()` method to automatically decompress gzip-encoded request bodies if the `Content-Encoding` header indicates gzip.

classes.name: GzipRoute
classes.description: A custom subclass of `APIRoute` that uses `GzipRequest` as the request class to handle gzip-encoded requests transparently.

methods.name: GzipRequest.body
methods.description: Overridden method to return the request body, decompressing it if the `Content-Encoding` header specifies gzip.

methods.name: GzipRoute.get_route_handler
methods.description: Overrides the default route handler to replace the request class with `GzipRequest`, enabling automatic gzip decompression.
